concrete_scene.heading: Worked trace: one bounded architecture repair
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: A deployed code model, two differentiated repair branches, independent evaluators, an integration planner, an archive, and a physical compiler.
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Repair a recurring concurrency-bug weakness without treating identical replicas, evaluator votes, or a convenient weight average as evidence of retained learning.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: The branches prove complementary but interfere under weight averaging; a routed specialist survives validation, then its slow-tier placement violates the online latency budget and narrows deployment to high-risk review.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The trace tests whether typed identity, evaluation, integration, retention, and realization receipts expose decisions hidden by a generic fork-and-merge diagram.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: Training, evaluation, integration, resource, rights, archive, deployment, rollback, and topology-control owners retain their separate residuals.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The scene is a worked design trace derived from the source, not an observed learning campaign, model-quality result, compiler validation, scaling law, safety result, or support-state promotion.

worked_trace.heading: Worked trace: one bounded architecture repair
worked_trace.maximum_inference: A typed learning-process representation can make identity, evaluator correlation, integration choice, retained alternatives, and physical realization leakage inspectable; it does not establish that the proposed process improves a natural learning system.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The simpler baselines are no branch, one competent repair lineage, fixed branching, ordinary weight averaging, and a specialist module; ABVI or adaptive rewrites must beat them after evaluation, integration, storage, rollback, and governance cost.
readable_claim: Hardware parallelism and learning plurality are different. Count persistent adaptive histories, not devices, and name the evidence, judgement, credit, integration, and authority that connect them.
normative_rule: Freeze a resolution contract; type every adaptive store and consequential edge; compile through a semantic firewall; return a realization receipt; and test topology changes against competent matched baselines with reversible integration and complete cost.

formal_binding.anchor: represent the learning process as a typed, versioned, provenance-bearing, rewritable causal topology

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: Each formal, executable, manual, analytical, and hypothetical contribution retains its exact evidence state where it is introduced.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Representation adequacy, normalization agreement, compiler correctness, natural learning benefit, topology causality, safety, transfer, and scaling remain separate unresolved burdens.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The reader chapter keeps the concrete mechanism, equivalence distinctions, phase questions, and experimental decisions visible; package custody, checksums, exhaustive coverage, and passage dispositions remain in the source note and paper library.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: Long source enumerations were converted into discriminating tables and short mechanism paragraphs with explicit comparison questions.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: Evidence boundaries appear next to the proposition, prototype, phase-study, and supplemental-hypothesis material they constrain.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: Tables are retained only where they prevent semantic collapse across topology layers, conformance, equivalence, propositions, control coordinates, phase studies, and experiment families.

non_claims: The worked repair trace is not a natural neural-training experiment.
The passing v0.1 package does not establish compiler correctness or E-level topology synthesis.
The morphology and long-horizon transformation sections do not establish a scaling law, safe self-improvement, support promotion, SOTA, AGI, or ASI.
